en: I cannot log in to my account
I am having trouble logging in
or: mu account re login kari paruni
hi: main login nahi kar pa raha hoon
mera login nahi ho raha hai
main account mein login nahi kar pa raha hoon
login mein problem ho rahi hai
mera account login nahi ho raha hai
mixed: mu account re login nahi kariparuni
main account re login kari paruni
login re problem ho rahi hai

answers.en: Please check that you are using the correct login credentials. If you still cannot access your account, please contact the support team through Help & Support.
answers.or: Dayakari tume correct login credentials use karuchha ki check kara. Jadi tathapi account access hei parunahi, Help & Support madhyama re support team ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Kripya check karein ki aap sahi login credentials use kar rahe hain. Agar phir bhi account access nahi ho raha hai, to Help & Support ke through support team se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Please check kara je tume correct login credentials use karuchha. Jadi account access heuni, Help & Support madhyama re support team ku contact kara.

en: How can I reset my password?
I need to reset my password
How do I change my password?
hi: main apna password bhool gaya hoon
main apna password kaise change karun
mixed: mu password bhuli gali, kaise reset karibi

answers.en: Use the password reset option on the login page to reset your account password. If the reset process does not work, contact the support team.
answers.or: Login page re thiba password reset option use kari account password reset kara. Jadi reset process work na kare, support team ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Login page par diye gaye password reset option ka use karke apna account password reset karein. Agar reset process kaam nahi karta hai, to support team se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Login page re thiba password reset option use kari password reset kara. Jadi work na kare, support team ku contact kara.

en: How can I update my profile?
How do I change my profile information?
I want to update my profile
How can I edit my account details?
hi: main apna profile kaise update karun
main apna profile edit karna chahta hoon
mixed: mora profile information kemiti change karibi
main profile re details kemiti edit karibi

answers.en: You can update your available profile information from the Profile section of your Tech Monster account.
answers.or: Tume Tech Monster account ra Profile section madhyama re available profile information update karipariba.
answers.hi: Aap apne Tech Monster account ke Profile section se available profile information update kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Tume Tech Monster account ra Profile section madhyama re available profile information update karipariba.
